notes.title: Race to the Top
notes.content:
I heard the suggestions: Please let me refund some upgrades. Now you can! But only all or nothing: Refund all upgrades, or stick with them. But don't worry, you'll get all your coins back.

With this new feature, you can find the best upgrade setup to reach the top the fastest. And to help you figure it out, there's now a timer!

The timer will start once the level starts and count on until you reach height 1200. Once you reach the 1200 mark, your time will also be submitted to steam, so expect some more achievements based on the fastest times!

notes.title: Finally: Achievements
notes.content:
It took some time to get used to the Steam API, but finally they are here: Steam Achievements.

There are 7 in total:

Three coin collection milestones: Collect 10 coins, 500 coins, or... enough coins.

Four are for the core mechanic: Height. Reach the milestone of 1 arbitrary distance unit! Or go all the way to 1200 to find the end! Close to 500 you will find some encouragement if you lose your determination.

Lastly, if you are bored enough: Go for the raccoon vs cactus milestone at 4000 height.

notes.title: Leaderboards!
notes.content:
It's my pleasure to anounce, I finally got around to integrate the Steamworks API into shitty cactus. This means: Leaderboards, Statistics and Achievements!

Unfortunately, Achievements will take a bit more work, but rest asured: They will come! Maybe even soon.
